messages:
Priya: quick Q — we have a legacy mobile client that sends routing params as `model_hint=redwood-v1` and `tier=standard`. I want to confirm server contract: if we introduce a new `fallback_policy` param and a different `model_id` format, should old clients get a 400, or do we need to ignore unknown params and keep previous behavior?

Alex: we should not 400 on unknown query params, that breaks OTA clients. prefer ignore-with-log + telemetry. :thumbsup:

Marta: confirmation — so plan is: unknown params are ignored, but if the client sends an explicit `routing_version=2` header we honor new fields and new model_id format, right?

Priya: yes that's the proposal. example new request: 
```
POST /v1/generate?model_hint=rw-v2&tier=pro
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <token>
  x-routing-version: 2
Body: {"input":"hi"}
```
If x-routing-version absent, server must behave like v1 (no fallback_policy, preserve response shape).

Sam: small nit — do we call the header `x-routing-version` or `x-inference-contract`? we already have a few custom headers.

Chris: keep it short: `x-routing-version` is fine. we'll document it in the API changelog.

Marta: what about a new response field we want to add, e.g. `model_chain` for multi-model routing? Adding fields is usually safe (clients should ignore extra JSON), but some strict parsers break. Any strict parsers on mobile?

Priya: mobile uses a thin JSON parser that tolerates extra fields. web clients are fine. but some internal SDKs do strict mapping — we'll need to version SDKs and add a compatibility flag.

Alex: operationally: implement server so that by default it responds with the old JSON keys. If x-routing-version=2, include `model_chain` and `applied_fallback`. Also log an event: routing_version_inferred: v1 or v2.

Sam: telemetry requirements? we should track: number_of_v2_requests, number_of_unknown_params, fallback_triggered_count, per-region breakdown.

Priya: agreed. add a daily job to surface clients that send unknown params > 1% of their requests. we'll notify SDK owners.

Chris: regression risk: if we change default model selection (e.g., map `redwood-v1` -> `rw-legacy` internally) we must keep the mapping stable for 6 months and provide a deprecation header `x-deprecation-info: new-model-id=rw-legacy;remove-at=2026-10-01`.

Marta: sounds reasonable. we should also publish a compatibility test in the CI matrix that runs a suite of requests with no header (v1) and with header (v2) and asserts response schema differences.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started: routing-contract/compatibility-tests (matrix: v1,v2) — build #452 queued.

Alex: one more edge case — proxies that canonicalize query params might drop unknown params. doc that clients must set `x-routing-version` header for opt-in instead of relying on query params.

Priya: action items: 
- Alex: add server ignore-unknown-params + logging (ETA 2d)
- Marta: update API changelog and create deprecation header format (ETA 1d)
- Sam: add telemetry counters and dashboard (ETA 3d)
- Chris: add CI compatibility matrix and tests (ETA 2d)
- Priya: coordinate SDK releases and announcement (ETA 5d)

Priya: any objections or missing items? :eyes:

Sam: no objections. thumbs up from infra.

Marta: +1

Alex: good plan. will ping when PR is up.

Chris: no blockers from SRE side.

Priya: thanks all — I'll track in the eng board and post the changelog link here when ready.
__notes: This thread documents an async Q&A about introducing new routing parameters and maintaining backward compatibility for legacy clients.
